description: Targets copied from saved notebook stdout output: final love numbers and steps required. Every love entry is still the notebook's, and is what each case is checked against. One exception, noted on the case itself: 4layer's steps_required was re-recorded after that case's integration tolerance was raised to a reachable one, because a step count only means anything at the tolerance that produced it.

targets.steps_note: Re-recorded 2026-09-22 at integration_rtol 1e-12 / atol 1e-15. The notebook ran this case at rtol 1e-18, below double precision, where the integrator cannot meet its tolerance and the step controller chases roundoff: the counts there were [[472, 324, 340], [6324, 6762, 6430], [57, 58, 0], [78, 87, 822]], a one-ulp change in a single input density moved them by up to 25 percent, and platforms disagreed by 18 percent. At 1e-12 the same nudge moves them by at most 3 percent and the love numbers below are still matched to 6e-7 relative, so nothing about the physics comparison is lost.
